description:
A true forever piece. The Classic Tennis Necklace features approximately 15 carats total weight of natural round brilliant diamonds, individually set in a timeless four-prong setting for an uninterrupted line of brilliance.

Part of our Estate Collection, it was selected for its exceptional presence, craftsmanship, and enduring appeal.
care: Store flat and separate from other pieces, and clean gently to protect the diamonds and four-prong settings.
shipping: Viewing, final availability, payment, and insured delivery details are confirmed directly before purchase.
